arStrings.szText:
You have {c_number}[SF_5 * 100|%|]{/c} reduced Maximum Life but any damage you would take is dealt to your Mana before your Life. If you have not taken damage in the last {c_number}[SF_7]{/c} seconds, your Mana Regeneration is increased by {c_number}[SF_8 * 100|%+|]{/c}.

You gain {c_random}[SF_1 * 100|%|]{/c} increased Maximum Mana and each point of Intelligence also increases your Maximum Mana by {c_number}[SF_6]{/c}.
Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
